classic_fallback.warning: Classic VMaNGOS kill, cap, rounding and spillover estimates; Forever server behavior may differ.

provenance.attribution: Data from Efficient Games (https://efficient.games), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Changed: filtered selected reputation quests; rewards converted from hundredths; local DB availability joined.
provenance.imported_database_confidence: Merged database without field-level winning-source provenance; repeatability is special_flags & 1, not a verified live Forever repeat.

daily_policy.required_items_policy: Reserve both the starting writ and every other required item per completion; item consumption by the trade script was not observed.
daily_policy.daily_circuit_policy: Each eligible daily quest once per reset, then repeat the circuit after a reset; first availability is unknown without live state.

daily_summary.theoretical_min_cycles_formula: ceil(max(0,target-start-one_time_rewards)/19875); lower bound only, conditional on every writ and material available; time to first usable reset unknown

limitations: No complete automatic acquisition support for any Durotar writ: every starting writ item has zero m_item_source rows and zero vendor rows.
Most classic repeatables have no primary Forever quest-cache or completed-turn-in observations in62public datasets.
daily classification uses actual server flags plus documented enum, not observed second-day completion; exact reset time/global daily cap unverified.
Do not treat positive reward arrays or NULL cap fields as proof of repeatability, caplessness, or zero cost.
